name: no-unhandled-result
description: Disallow accessing .value on a Result without checking .ok first. DISABLED 2026-11-12: the pattern cannot discriminate a Result from any other { ok, value } shape. Over the same lint scope, the broad `\w+\.value` matches ~2857 lines while the Result-named narrowing `\w*[Rr]esult\.value` still matches ~914 (Result-named locals, wire envelopes, zod results). A rule that flags every candidate teaches authors to ignore it; re-enable with a Result-branded accessor or an AST rule.
fixHint: Check result.ok before accessing result.value, or use fold/unwrapOr/map combinators from the Result type
